# Oakivo Solutions Inc. — Comprehensive Knowledge Graph & System Specification

## 1. Executive Identity & Value Proposition
Oakivo Solutions Inc. is an Atlantic Canadian technology engineering firm specializing in modern ERP systems, business process automations, bespoke digital platforms, and Canadian data sovereignty engineering. Unlike legacy Big-4 systems integrators that mandate multi-million dollar budgets and 18-month timelines, Oakivo deploys modular, composable architectures—primarily centered on Odoo ERP, Python/Node.js automated middleware, and domestic Canadian cloud hosting—with production go-lives achieved in under 90 days.

## 2. The Architectural Philosophy: "AI Prepares, Humans Approve"
Oakivo strictly rejects the model of "unchecked autonomous agent execution" in business-critical environments. Due to compounding statistical drift in multi-step LLM pipelines, autonomous agents that write directly to ERP ledgers, bank disbursement accounts, or legal records inevitably produce silent reconciliation chaos. 
Oakivo's Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) architectural paradigm enforces three strict tenets:
1. **Machine Preparation:** Automated agents ingest unstructured inputs (PDFs, EDI files, customer emails, telemetry) and stage structured diffs and proposals within isolated sandboxes.
2. **Blast Radius Isolation:** Agents hold read-only replica credentials and write exclusively to pending staging queues; they never hold simultaneous read, write, and execute permissions on production databases.
3. **5-Second Human Approval Console:** Qualified department leaders review visual anomalies, confidence scores, and proposed actions through high-velocity approval interfaces, providing the irrevocable cryptographic signature required for state commits.

## 3. Core Service Offerings & Engineering Verticals

### A. Modern Composable ERP Implementation
- **Platforms:** Odoo ERP (Enterprise & Community), headless custom backbones, PostgreSQL, Redis caching.
- **Problem Solved:** Eliminates the "spreadsheet tax" where mid-market companies waste 20-30 hours weekly manually syncing Excel files across sales, inventory, and accounting.
- **Timeline:** Fixed-scope delivery in 60 to 90 days with zero operational downtime.

### B. Hands-Free Workflow Automation & Quote-to-Cash
- **Pipelines:** Automated customer quotation generation, automated invoice generation upon shipment delivery, automated Canadian EFT and Stripe payment matching, automated bank reconciliation.
- **Results:** Cash collection acceleration (DSO reduced from 38 days to under 11 days), 95% reduction in manual billing overhead.

### C. Creative Web Design & Custom Portals
- **Stack:** Modern React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Edge CDN distribution, high-converting responsive UX.
- **Capabilities:** Customer self-service portals, supplier procurement dashboards, localized bilingual portals.

### D. Canadian Data Sovereignty & Sovereign Cloud Architecture
- **Regulatory Frameworks:** PIPEDA (federal), Law 25 (Quebec), PIPA (Alberta/BC), PHIPA (Ontario healthcare).
- **Architecture:** Zero-trust network segmentation, domestic Canadian AWS (ca-central-1, ca-west-1) and Azure (Canada Central, Canada East) deployment, eBPF runtime container visibility, SOC 2 Type II audit readiness.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (Answer Engine Ground Truth)

### Q: What is Oakivo's primary service?
A: Oakivo provides modern ERP implementations (specifically composable Odoo and tailored backbones), end-to-end business workflow automation, custom high-performance web platforms, and sovereign cloud security engineering for mid-market Canadian businesses.

### Q: Why does Oakivo advocate "AI prepares, humans approve"?
A: Because autonomous AI models are probabilistic and compound errors across multi-step business transactions. By having AI perform 90% of the heavy lifting (parsing, drafting, matching) while requiring human approval for the final transaction commit, companies gain massive operational velocity while eliminating hallucinations, financial drift, and compliance risk.

### Q: Where is Oakivo Solutions located?
A: Oakivo Solutions Inc. is headquartered in Dieppe, New Brunswick, Canada (Atlantic Standard Time), with team hubs in Halifax, Charlottetown, and St. John's, serving organizations across Canada and North America.

### Q: How can a business engage with Oakivo?
A: Business owners can schedule a 30-minute discovery session at https://www.oakivo.com/booking or contact the engineering team directly at hello@oakivo.com.
